title: 소재 컷을 잇는 전환 5종
prompt: An 11-second 9:16 reel that joins six footage cuts with five different transitions, all built inside the graphic language and never as crossfades. 1) Cover: a small accent dot near the bottom grows into a circle that floods the frame, the footage swaps under it, and the circle shrinks into the round window of the next clip. 2) Zoom-through: the camera pushes into that window while the next clip opens inside it and fills the frame. 3) Match cut: the frame pushes left with motion blur at the cut, and a white ring around the yellow circle lands exactly on the orange circle of the next clip. 4) Dimension shift: the clip shrinks into a tilted card and slides away while the next card swings in and flattens to full frame. 5) Flash: four fast diagonal streaks in white and brand pink cross the frame, and as the last thick one passes the screen flashes pink for six frames while the footage cuts. Keep the footage at full clarity, no dim or haze.

title: 지도 경로: 서울 → 부산 배송
prompt: A 6-second 9:16 delivery ad over night-street footage. An outline map of Korea (white borders with a soft shadow, no fill) fades in, Seoul fills with the accent color and a pin pops, then a curved route draws from Seoul to Busan while the map zooms 1.55x toward the route. Busan lights up with its own pin and label. A bottom text band (30% height, max 0.6 opacity) carries a sub line and a headline with an underline wipe. Footage stays clearly visible.

title: GSAP + three.js 무선 이어폰 런칭 티저
prompt: A 6-second 9:16 launch teaser for wireless earbuds called AURA Buds, over the user's footage. A 3D ring object rises from below while the camera inside the scene pushes in and the ring settles with a back-out ease. A hook line rises, then a two-line headline lands with a small punch, the second line four frames late. Three spec chips pop one per beat and the 3D core pulses on the same beats. Copy exits at half its entrance length, the 3D lifts away, and the wordmark with CTA and an underline wipe holds for over a second. The 3D background is transparent so the footage stays visible.

title: 손글씨: 오늘도 수고했어요 / thank you
prompt: A 5-second 9:16 warm closing card over a still photo. The Korean line "오늘도 수고했어요" in a pen-script font writes on letter by letter and keeps a subtle hand-drawn boil the whole time. Below it, "thank you" in a casual script is drawn stroke by stroke in warm yellow, slightly tilted, then fills. No dimming over the photo; legibility comes from a soft text shadow only.

title: 모션 스타일 5종: 키네틱 타이포 · 스쿼시 · 아이소메트릭(평면/입체) · 리퀴드 · 파티클 로고
prompt: A 21-second 9:16 reel that shows five motion-graphic styles over six footage clips, 3.5 seconds each, with everything transparent over the footage. 1) Kinetic type: "SEE IT", "LOVE IT", "OWN IT" slam in one per beat at 120 BPM, a full-width brand-blue bar wipes in behind "LOVE IT", earlier lines punch on each new beat, and on the next beat all lines squash and spring back. 2) Squash and stretch: three blue balls drop in with phase offsets, flatten on contact, stretch as they rise, cast shrinking shadows, and settle with a wobble before "LOADING" bounces in. 3) Flat isometric: a pastel block city builds from back to front, each block rising from the bottom with a small landing squash. 4) The same city in real 3D with an orthographic camera that slowly orbits 40 degrees after it builds. 5) Liquid: glossy blue metaballs swell in, drift and merge, with "STAY CURIOUS" below. 6) Particle logo: scattered twinkling dots swirl together into the word "CREATE". No dim or haze over the footage.
